commands.description: Runs several edit and query Commands as one atomic edit: if any step fails, every step is rolled back. Later steps refer to objects created by earlier ones through UUIDs the caller supplied in the earlier step's params. Returns the combined changes and each step's result, in order.

id.description: An edit or query Command id, or one of their Presets as `<id>:<preset>`.

params.description: The step's params, as the Command takes them on its own.

commands.title: Batch

commands.description: Redoes the newest undone edit on one undo stack: a Document's, or the Project file's with `document: "project"`. Any new edit on that stack clears what could be redone.

document.description: The stack: a Document's UUID, or `"project"` for the Project file's own stack.

label.description: The label of the entry undone or redone, such as "Add Wire".

commands.title: Redo

commands.description: Undoes the newest edit on one undo stack: a Document's, or the Project file's with `document: "project"`. A cross-Document edit has one entry in each Document it touched, undone independently.

document.description: The stack: a Document's UUID, or `"project"` for the Project file's own stack.

label.description: The label of the entry undone or redone, such as "Add Wire".
